title: Albertsons Companies, Inc. — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for Albertsons Companies, Inc., covering 30 recall actions across its 2,270-store network. Recurring supplier-driven Listeria and Salmonella contamination in ReadyMeals and deli products highlights the systemic food safety challenges facing America's second-largest grocery chain.
seo_title: Albertsons FDA Recalls & Enforcement Actions | Policy Canary
seo_description: Complete enforcement intelligence on Albertsons Companies: 30 FDA recall actions, Listeria and Salmonella contamination events, supplier chain failures from BrucePac and Fresh Creative Foods, and what it means for the retail food safety industry.
